location_description: Comstock Park is an unincorporated community and census-designated place (CDP) in Kent County in the U.S. state of Michigan.  The population was 10,088 at the 2010 census.  The community is located within Alpine Township to the west and Plainfield Township to the east.The community is part of the Grand Rapids metropolitan area, with the city of Walker to the south and Grand Rapids just to the southeast.
